component.name: VaultLeaf Backup
component.summary: Friendly encrypted backups and safe file recovery

description.p: VaultLeaf Backup manages encrypted local, network, and cloud backups through a guided GTK interface powered by restic and rclone.
Adds full shutdown/resume of backup services from the tray and menu, and fixes a Setup page crash on already-configured systems.
Shows an "already set up" state in Setup and adds one-time permanent admin permission for bootable monthly image backups.
Adds self-healing startup, installs the newest restic/rclone, replica verification, and bootable monthly system images.
Automatically adopts existing setup and resumes interrupted backups after login until complete.
Streamlines first-run AppImage handoff and recovery state for upgraded installations.
Installs one stable AppImage, reopens the running application, and adds manual and interrupted-backup continuation controls.
Fixes the VaultLeaf tray, taskbar, dock, and application-menu icons.
Fixes startup on Linux systems with newer GLib application flags.
Adds signed updates and verifiable GitHub build provenance.
Adds native x86-64 and ARM64 releases, verified updates, and safe uninstall.
